title: Detect cycles while inspecting nested imported acceptance proofs
outcome: Explicit imported-acceptance inspection detects revisited proof or decision identity and refuses cyclic foreign chains without repeating the full nesting limit.
acceptance: Nested imported-acceptance inspection detects cyclic proof or decision identity while preserving legitimate acyclic proof chains and origin qualification.
